title.value: RELATING TO HEALTH AND SAFETY -- TOXIC PACKAGING REDUCTION ACT
title.provenance: An Act RELATING TO HEALTH AND SAFETY -- TOXIC PACKAGING REDUCTION ACT

pfas_definition.provenance: “Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances” or “PFAS” means all members of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: (d) Effective January 1, 2024, no food package to which PFAS have been intentionally introduced during manufacturing or distribution in any amount shall be offered for sale or for promotional purposes by its manufacturer or distributor in the state.
